How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Questions to ask the vendor (7)

  1. Has Aikido Security reduced headcount in the last 24 months, and by how much?
    Layoffs can reduce support and product capacity.
  2. Can Aikido Security provide its latest filed annual accounts, including revenue, net result and cash position?
    Filed accounts show revenue, losses and cash, which venture funding announcements do not.
  3. Has Aikido Security been subject to any regulatory investigation, enforcement action or order in the last five years?
    A regulatory action against a supplier can create reputational and supervisory exposure for a bank.
  4. Is Aikido Security party to any pending or recently concluded litigation, including patent claims, and what is each matter about?
    Material litigation can affect a supplier's finances and its ability to deliver.
  5. Has Aikido Security had any security incident affecting its platform or customer data in the last five years, and what was disclosed to customers?
    A security incident at a security supplier can expose the bank's code and findings.
  6. Has Aikido Security lost any financial-services customers in the last 24 months, and why?
    Loss of large customers can signal product or service problems.
  7. Have any founders or executives left Aikido Security in the last 24 months, and are there any disputes involving its leadership?
    Leadership disputes or departures can disrupt a young supplier.

The capability is offered as Aikido Libraries and Aikido Images. Terms were not disclosed.
